description:
The Term Loan Scheme under the Gramin Tirth Yatra Kendra Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) was launched by the Government of India in 2018. 

This scheme aims to promote tourism in rural areas by providing financial assistance to individuals and groups involved in tourism-related activities. 

The primary objective of the Term Loan Scheme is to enhance the income of rural entrepreneurs by enabling them to establish and expand tourism facilities. 

The scheme specifically targets the development of infrastructure such as guest houses, homestays, and other tourism-related services in rural regions. 

The GTKVN aims to create at least 10,000 new jobs in the tourism sector by the end of 2025. 

The scheme also seeks to increase the number of domestic and international tourists visiting rural areas by 20% annually. 

Under this scheme, eligible applicants can avail of loans ranging from INR 1 lakh to INR 25 lakhs. 

The loan amount is determined based on the project cost and the financial viability of the proposed tourism venture. 

The interest rate for the loans under this scheme is set at 7% per annum. 

The repayment period for the loans can extend up to 7 years, including a moratorium period of 6 months. 

Eligibility for the Term Loan Scheme includes individuals, self-help groups, and cooperatives engaged in tourism-related activities. 

Applicants must be at least 18 years old and should have a valid identification document. 

The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 5 lakhs to qualify for the scheme. 

Educational qualifications are not a strict requirement; however, applicants with experience in the tourism sector are preferred. 

To apply for the Term Loan Scheme, applicants must follow a specific process. 

First, they need to prepare a detailed project report outlining their proposed tourism business. 

The project report should include information about the location, type of services offered, and estimated costs. 

Next, applicants must visit the nearest GTKVN office or the designated bank branch to obtain the application form. 

The completed application form must be submitted along with the project report and necessary documents. 

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of address, income certificate, and any licenses related to tourism operations. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the GTKVN officials. 

The approval process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission. 

If approved, the loan amount will be disbursed in one or two installments based on the project requirements. 

The first installment is usually released after the completion of necessary documentation and verification. 

The scheme also includes provisions for training and capacity building for the beneficiaries. 

Training programs are organized in collaboration with various tourism development agencies. 

These programs aim to equip beneficiaries with essential skills in hospitality management and customer service. 

The GTKVN also provides marketing support to promote the tourism ventures established under this scheme. 

Beneficiaries can access promotional materials and participate in tourism fairs organized by the government. 

The implementing authority for the Term Loan Scheme is the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. 

The GTKVN operates under the Ministry and has various regional offices across the country. 

Individuals can contact the nearest GTKVN office for assistance with the application process. 

The contact details for the Ministry of Tourism can be found on their official website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to boost rural tourism and enhance the livelihoods of rural communities. 

It aligns with the government's vision of promoting sustainable tourism practices in rural areas. 

The Term Loan Scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the overall growth of the tourism sector in India. 

By 2025, the government aims to increase the contribution of tourism to the GDP by 10%. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have successfully established their tourism ventures. 

Many beneficiaries report increased income and improved living standards as a result of the financial assistance provided. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 500 crores for the implementation of the Term Loan Scheme. 

This budget is expected to support at least 20,000 beneficiaries over the next five years. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of environmental sustainability in tourism development. 

Beneficiaries are encouraged to adopt eco-friendly practices in their operations. 

The GTKVN conducts regular monitoring and evaluation of the projects funded under this scheme. 

This ensures that the objectives of the scheme are being met and that the funds are utilized effectively. 

In conclusion, the Term Loan Scheme under GTKVN is a significant initiative aimed at promoting rural tourism. 

It provides financial assistance and support to aspiring entrepreneurs in the tourism sector. 

The scheme not only aims to enhance the income of individuals but also contributes to the overall development of rural areas. 

With specific eligibility criteria and a structured application process, the scheme is accessible to a wide range of applicants. 

The government’s commitment to promoting sustainable tourism practices further enhances the scheme’s impact. 

Overall, the Term Loan Scheme represents a crucial step towards empowering rural communities through tourism development.
